summary.text: DALE MALO HOLDING AS is a private limited company registered in Elnesvågen, founded 2016-01-04. DALE MALO HOLDING AS is engaged in trade in building materials and contracting activities, including the development, construction and sale of plots, residential properties, leisure properties and commercial properties. The company is a holding company for companies that carry on these activities, and for activities naturally connected therewith. Its main industry code is 41.000: construction of residential and non-residential buildings. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 2 573 906 NOK and the annual result was -20 150 825 NOK; operating income was up from 2 549 306 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 546 579 NOK in 2024 to -20 150 825 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 112 014 274 NOK in 2024 to 91 863 449 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-11 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
